metadata.description: Source-linked admission, entrance examination and counselling process references for Indian higher education.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Use official sources for each claim. Recheck time-sensitive details, eligibility, schedules, fees and procedures against the applicable admission cycle before relying on them.
notes: This dataset provides process guidance and official references; it does not guarantee eligibility, admission, recognition or seat allocation.
Counselling procedures, registration windows, fee requirements, eligibility conditions and reporting instructions can change each academic year.
Null date fields mean that no confirmed date is recorded in this dataset. They must not be displayed as zero dates or interpreted as evidence that registration is open.
The lastVerified field records the date a record was reviewed; it does not establish that every process detail has been independently verified.
The applicable academic cycle must be confirmed from the relevant authority's current notice before publication or use.
Official portal links are entry points. Before publishing cycle-specific instructions, confirm that the linked page supports the associated claims.
Process steps are general guidance and must be reconciled with the current official bulletin, information brochure, business rules and notices.

records.name: NEET UG All India Quota counselling
records.description: Centralised online counselling for undergraduate medical and dental seats handled by MCC under the applicable counselling rules.
steps: Read the current MCC UG information bulletin, eligibility rules and counselling schedule.
Confirm examination result, eligibility, category and applicable seat type against current rules.
Register through the official MCC UG counselling portal when the relevant window opens.
Complete registration and pay applicable counselling and security fees according to the current bulletin.
Review participating institutions, course availability, seat information and applicable quota rules.
Fill choices in preference order and lock them before the official deadline.
Check the published allotment result and download the allotment letter when issued.
Complete required online acceptance, fee payment, document verification and reporting as instructed.
Review current rules for later rounds, resignation, upgrades, forfeiture and refunds before taking further action.
records.verificationNotes: Check the current MCC bulletin and round-specific notices. Applicable seat types and participating institutions are determined by official counselling rules.

records.name: West Bengal UG Medical and Dental counselling
records.description: West Bengal state-level online counselling and seat allotment for eligible undergraduate medical and dental candidates under applicable state rules.
steps: Qualify NEET UG and read the current West Bengal UG Medical and Dental counselling bulletin.
Confirm eligibility, domicile requirements where applicable, category rules and available seat types.
Register on the official WBMCC portal during the notified period.
Complete registration and pay applicable fees.
Upload or present required documents and complete verification as instructed.
Review the official participating-institution list, seat matrix, quota rules and fee notices.
Fill and lock college choices within the published window.
Check the official allotment result and read the allotted-seat instructions.
Complete required fee payment, document submission and reporting within the prescribed deadline.
Review current rules for later rounds, resignation, upgrades, forfeiture and refunds.
records.verificationNotes: Verify the current WBMCC notice for the applicable course, seat type and round. Do not infer dates from a previous cycle.

records.name: Uttar Pradesh NEET UG counselling
records.authority: Director General of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh
records.description: Online Uttar Pradesh undergraduate medical and dental counselling under the applicable state policy and current notifications.
steps: Read the current UP NEET UG policy, information brochure and official schedule.
Confirm examination eligibility, domicile and category requirements, and rules for the relevant seat type.
Register on the official portal when registration is open.
Complete application details and pay the applicable registration fee.
Upload required documents and check verification status.
Pay any applicable security fee under the current rules.
Review participating institutions, current seat matrix, course options and official fee information.
Fill and lock choices during the notified window.
Check allotment results and follow the instructions for the allotted seat.
Complete admission formalities and report within the official deadline.
Check current rules for further rounds, resignation, refunds and re-participation.
records.verificationNotes: Use the current UP NEET UG policy, schedule and notices. Previous-round rules and dates may not apply.

records.name: CUET UG participating-university admissions
records.authority: National Testing Agency and participating universities
records.description: Entrance examination and subsequent university-specific admission processes for participating undergraduate programmes.
steps: Read the current CUET UG information bulletin and confirm eligibility and examination requirements.
Review participating universities, programmes, subject combinations and programme-specific conditions.
Submit the examination application through the official CUET UG portal during the notified window.
Pay the prescribed examination fee and save the confirmation.
Complete any permitted correction process within the official window.
Download the admit card and follow examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and check official notices about answer keys, objections and results.
After results, check each university's separate admission portal and programme requirements.
Register for university admission or counselling where required and submit documents.
Accept an offered seat and complete the university's fee payment and reporting requirements.
records.verificationNotes: Examination administration and university admissions are separate stages. Universities may set independent schedules and eligibility conditions.

records.name: JoSAA engineering seat allocation
records.description: Centralised seat allocation for participating technical institutions under the applicable JoSAA eligibility and business rules.
steps: Read current JoSAA business rules, eligibility requirements, schedule and institute-specific programme criteria.
Confirm qualifying examination, rank, category and other admission requirements.
Register on the official portal during the notified registration and choice-filling period.
Review participating institutes, programmes, seat matrix and eligibility restrictions.
Fill institute and programme choices in preference order.
Review and lock choices before the official deadline.
Check each round's seat allocation result and acceptance instructions.
Complete online reporting, document upload, verification responses and seat acceptance fee payment as required.
Follow current rules for available seat-allocation options, where applicable.
Complete further fee and reporting formalities as instructed.
records.verificationNotes: Check current JoSAA business rules and schedule. Requirements can differ by institution group and admission category.

records.name: NEET UG examination application
records.description: National entrance examination application and examination process for undergraduate medical admissions as defined by applicable rules.
steps: Read the current NEET UG information bulletin and eligibility requirements.
Confirm personal details, qualifying examination status and applicable category requirements.
Submit the application through the official NEET UG portal within the announced window.
Upload required photographs, signature and other documents in the prescribed formats.
Pay the applicable examination fee and retain the confirmation and receipt.
Use the official correction window if corrections are permitted and necessary.
Monitor notices about examination city, admit card, examination date and permitted documents.
Appear for the examination according to published instructions.
Check official answer-key notices, permitted objection procedures and results.
Use the result to review eligibility for relevant counselling processes, each with separate rules and registration.
records.verificationNotes: Examination registration is separate from counselling registration. Verify the current information bulletin and revised notices.

records.name: CSAB Special Rounds for NIT+ System seats
records.description: Special seat-allocation rounds for eligible vacant seats in the NIT+ System after applicable JoSAA rounds, subject to current CSAB rules.
steps: Read the current CSAB Special Rounds brochure, eligibility rules and schedule.
Confirm eligibility and rules for candidates who participated in JoSAA or hold an allocated seat.
Check participating institutions, current seat matrix, vacancy details and programme restrictions.
Register on the official CSAB portal if required and eligible.
Complete prescribed fee payment and document-verification requirements.
Fill and lock choices according to CSAB-specific instructions and deadlines.
Check the official allocation result and instructions for the allocated seat.
Complete required acceptance fee payment, verification and reporting within the schedule.
Review rules concerning other allocation schemes, seat cancellation, refunds and later rounds.
records.verificationNotes: CSAB procedures differ from JoSAA. Verify the current CSAB brochure, eligibility, vacancy information and schedule.

records.name: JEE Main examination application
records.description: Application and examination process for JEE Main, subject to the current examination bulletin and programme-specific admission rules.
steps: Read the current JEE Main information bulletin, eligibility criteria and examination scheme.
Check the permitted sessions, subject requirements and applicable attempt rules.
Apply through the official JEE Main portal during the notified registration window.
Enter candidate details carefully and upload required documents in the prescribed format.
Pay the applicable examination fee and save the confirmation page.
Use any officially announced correction window if needed.
Monitor official notices for exam city information, admit card and examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and review official answer-key and result notices.
Check the applicable rules for using the score in JoSAA, CSAB or other authorised admission processes.
records.verificationNotes: Confirm current session dates, eligibility and score-use rules from the current NTA bulletin. JEE Main application is not the same as seat-allocation registration.

records.name: JEE Advanced examination and admission process
records.authority: Joint Admission Board and organising institute for the relevant year
records.description: Examination and subsequent admission pathway for eligible candidates seeking admission to participating IIT programmes under current JEE Advanced rules.
steps: Read the current JEE Advanced information brochure and eligibility criteria.
Confirm the applicable JEE Main qualification and other eligibility requirements.
Register on the official JEE Advanced portal if eligible and within the notified window.
Complete the application and pay the applicable examination fee.
Monitor official notices for admit card, examination instructions and permitted materials.
Appear for the examination and check official answer-key and result notices.
Review the current rank list and the separate JoSAA seat-allocation process.
Register for JoSAA when required and enter eligible programme choices.
Follow seat-allocation, acceptance, document-verification and reporting instructions.
records.verificationNotes: JEE Advanced eligibility and IIT seat allocation are governed by separate current-cycle rules. Confirm the current brochure and JoSAA rules.

records.name: INI-CET postgraduate admissions
records.authority: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
records.description: Common entrance examination and seat-allocation pathway for participating Institutes of National Importance postgraduate medical programmes, subject to current prospectus and rules.
steps: Read the current INI-CET prospectus and list of participating institutes and courses.
Confirm qualification, internship, registration and other eligibility requirements for the relevant session.
Register through the official AIIMS examinations portal during the notified window.
Complete the application, upload required documents and pay the prescribed examination fee.
Monitor official notices for application corrections, admit card and examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and check the official result and rank information.
Read the current seat-allocation notice and confirm institute- and course-specific eligibility.
Complete online choice filling and seat allocation steps as specified for the session.
Submit required certificates and complete acceptance, joining and reporting formalities within the official schedule.
records.verificationNotes: Verify the session-specific prospectus, participating institutes, course eligibility and seat-allocation notices. Do not infer current dates from an older session.

records.name: NEET PG MCC counselling
records.description: Centralised counselling reference for postgraduate medical seats handled by MCC under the applicable postgraduate counselling rules.
steps: Read the current MCC PG counselling bulletin and official schedule.
Confirm NEET PG qualification, registration and applicable eligibility conditions.
Review participating institutions, course options, seat matrix and applicable quota rules.
Register on the official MCC PG counselling portal during the notified window.
Pay applicable registration and security fees under the current bulletin.
Fill and lock eligible choices before the deadline.
Check round-wise allotment results and download the allotment letter if issued.
Complete required document verification, fee payment and joining or reporting formalities.
Review current rules for later rounds, resignation, upgrades, forfeiture and refunds.
records.verificationNotes: Confirm the current postgraduate counselling section and bulletin. NEET PG examination registration and counselling registration are separate processes.

records.name: CUET PG participating-university admissions
records.authority: National Testing Agency and participating universities
records.description: Entrance examination and university-specific admission pathway for participating postgraduate programmes.
steps: Read the current CUET PG information bulletin and confirm programme-specific eligibility.
Review participating universities, test-paper choices and subject requirements.
Apply through the official CUET PG portal during the notified window.
Pay the prescribed examination fee and save the application confirmation.
Complete any permitted correction process within the official window.
Download the admit card and follow examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and review official answer-key and result notices.
Check each participating university's admission portal for separate registration, merit and counselling requirements.
Submit documents and complete choice selection, fee payment and reporting as instructed by the university.
records.verificationNotes: University admission processes may be separate from CUET PG. Verify current NTA and university notices, programme eligibility and schedules.

records.name: CLAT UG participating-university admissions
records.description: Common Law Admission Test pathway for participating National Law Universities, subject to current CLAT rules and counselling notifications.
steps: Read the current CLAT notification, information brochure and eligibility criteria.
Review participating universities and programme-specific requirements.
Register through the official Consortium portal during the notified application window.
Complete the application and pay the prescribed fee.
Monitor official notices for admit card and examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and check the official result and rank information.
Follow the current counselling registration, preference and payment instructions if eligible.
Review allotment and undertaking requirements carefully before accepting or proceeding.
Complete required fee payment, document submission and admission formalities within the official schedule.
records.verificationNotes: Check the current CLAT notification and counselling instructions. Participating universities and rules may change by cycle.

records.name: NCHM JEE hospitality admissions
records.authority: National Testing Agency and National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology
records.description: Entrance examination reference for participating hospitality and hotel-management programmes under current NTA and NCHMCT instructions.
steps: Read the current NCHM JEE information bulletin and eligibility requirements.
Review participating institutes, programme details and admission conditions.
Apply through the official NTA examination portal when registration is announced.
Complete the application, upload required documents and pay the applicable examination fee.
Monitor official notices for correction windows, admit card and examination instructions.
Appear for the examination and check official result notices.
Follow the current NCHMCT counselling or admission instructions and institute-specific requirements.
Submit documents and complete fee payment and reporting as directed.
records.verificationNotes: Confirm the current examination portal, brochure, counselling authority and participating-institute information before publication.

records.name: Study in India international student admissions
records.authority: Study in India programme and participating institutions
records.description: Official programme reference for international students exploring eligible Indian higher-education institutions and courses.
steps: Review the official Study in India portal and current programme information.
Check participating institutions, courses, eligibility, language requirements and application instructions.
Confirm whether the selected institution requires a separate application or additional entrance examination.
Prepare academic records, identity documents and other documents listed by the institution or programme.
Submit applications through the official portal or the institution's authorised process, as directed.
Check official communication for admission decisions and any required fee or confirmation steps.
Confirm applicable visa and immigration requirements through official Indian government resources.
Verify all fees, scholarship terms, travel arrangements and enrolment requirements with the relevant authorities before making commitments.
records.verificationNotes: Programme availability, eligibility, scholarships and visa requirements vary. The portal does not replace institution-specific admission or official immigration instructions.
